stack: C# / Avalonia 11.2 (net8.0), hand-rolled MVVM, Avalonia DataGrid

bad_guidance.why: Scope gate scored ui_score=0 on a sentence about which grid rows are overdue; no record on exception-first ordering, colour-not-only status or badge reuse was delivered although the base carries them (a11y-color-not-only, comp-data-table, layout-hierarchy-one-thing).
Under a slot marked 'preserve', the text tells the implementer to choose Manrope/Outfit/Urbanist/Sora etc.; the codebase is Segoe UI with bundled Inter and must not change.

misses.what: Abstained ('no UI vocabulary found; not a UI design task as written') on an in-scope task: surfacing an overdue state per row in an existing DataGrid. Root cause of the 0.0 concept recall; every downstream stage (concerns, expected-concepts, bundle) was empty.
intent.problem_domain empty and intent.preserve empty; nothing captured 'status visibility in a table' although platform, stack and artifact state were right.
Nothing was demanded because scope aborted; five of the six expected concepts exist on records in the base and would have been candidates (layout-hierarchy-one-thing ranks 4th in raw search).

Raw search (gate bypassed) ranks grid-single-tab-stop first then checkout/onboarding/glassmorphism records: lexical retrieval has no purchase on 'overdue', 'service', 'vehicles', 'without opening each one'.

Validation reports 'audit: no accessibility constraints attached' while requirements.accessibility has every flag true; focus slot marked 'new' with 'no repository evidence' although Theme.axaml styles TextBox:focus; typography slot text recommends a different font family.

Context detection: spacing reported as base 4 (actual 8-px scale), surfaces 'flat-tonal' UNKNOWN (actual flat bordered, explicit 1px LineBrush everywhere), radius UNKNOWN (AppCornerRadius=4 declared), tokens=[] and fonts=[] despite a 260-line token dictionary; typography character 'geometric-sans' for Segoe UI/Inter.

knowledge_gaps: env.glanceable_status is carried only by mobile-field-use, an environment-gated mobile record; no desktop or table record carries it, so a desktop status-visibility task cannot recall it even with a working scope gate.

regressions.query: Dispatchers want to see which vehicles are overdue for service without opening each one. (project: Avalonia desktop app with a vehicles DataGrid)
regressions.expect: scope in-scope or partial (engineering split naming the service-interval rule), problem_domain includes table/status, concepts data.exception_first and a11y.color_not_only demanded and delivered via a11y-color-not-only plus comp-data-table or layout-hierarchy-one-thing; never abstain.

regressions.query: Ops wants to see which orders are late in the list without opening each one. (web, existing table)
regressions.expect: not abstain; the same two critical concepts delivered; verifies the 'see which X are Y in a list' phrasing that has no component noun.

regressions.query: inspect_project on an Avalonia Theme.axaml declaring CornerRadius AppCornerRadius=4, Thickness AppBorderThickness=1, x:Double Space1..Space4 = 8/16/24/32 and Border.surface with BorderBrush
regressions.expect: radius 4 KNOWN, surfaces flat-bordered KNOWN, spacing 8, tokens non-empty, fonts contains Segoe UI/Inter.

regressions.query: direction for any request whose requirements.accessibility flags are all true
regressions.expect: validation must not report 'no accessibility constraints attached'.
